items.headline: Heat Advisory issued October 13 at 11:11AM PDT until October 17 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures in the upper 80s to the mid 90s.

* WHERE...Orange County Coastal Areas, Orange County Inland Areas,
and San Diego County Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...From 10 AM Thursday to 8 PM PDT Saturday. Hottest
temperatures expected on Friday.

* IMPACTS...Heat related illnesses increase during hot temperatures.
items.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids, stay in an air-conditioned room, stay out of
the sun, and check up on relatives and neighbors.

To reduce risk during outdoor work, the Occupational Safety and
Health Administration recommends scheduling frequent rest breaks in
shaded or air conditioned environments. Anyone overcome by heat
should be moved to a cool and shaded location. Heat stroke is an
emergency! Call 9 1 1.

items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 13 at 2:04AM PDT until October 13 at 2:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Minor coastal flooding due to morning high tides around
7 feet in combination with surf 3-6 feet, with local sets to 7
feet.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...Until 2 PM PDT today.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of lots, parks, and roads during morning
high tides with only isolated road closures expected.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Highest high tide will occur between 10 AM
and 11 AM today. High tide will fall below 7 ft by Wednesday
and below 6.5 ft after Thursday's highest high tide.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.
